name: albums-angular-app
description: Root scripts only; frontend/ and backend/ keep their own dependencies

scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.refresh: npm run seed && npm run dev
scripts.update: git pull && npm run install:all && npm run refresh
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
